alchemistofblackspells.name: Alchemist of Black Spells
alchemistofblackspells.desc: Once per turn, you can change this face-up Attack Position card you control to face-up Defense Position and place 1 Spell Counter on a face-up card you control that you can place a Spell Counter on.

auramtheworldchaliceblademaster.name: Auram the World Chalice Blademaster
auramtheworldchaliceblademaster.desc:
2 "World Chalice" monsters
Gains 300 ATK for each "World Legacy" monster in your GY with a different name. You can Tribute 1 "World Chalice" monster this card points to, then target 1 other monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone this card points to. You can only use this effect of "Auram the World Chalice Blademaster" once per turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "World Chalice" monster from your hand.

battlefader.name: Battle Fader
battlefader.desc: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then end the Battle Phase. If Summoned this way, banish it when it leaves the field.

bootupsoldierdreaddynamo.name: Boot-Up Soldier - Dread Dynamo
bootupsoldierdreaddynamo.desc: While you control a "Gadget" monster, this card gains 2000 ATK.

cybergymnast.name: Cyber Gymnast
cybergymnast.desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

deusxkrawler.name: Deus X-Krawler
deusxkrawler.desc: When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets this face-down monster (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-up Defense Position; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. After this card was flipped face-up, while it is in the Monster Zone, negate all monster effects activated on your opponent's field. If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add, from your Deck to your hand, 1 Level 9 monster with a different original Type and Attribute than this card. You can only use this effect of "Deus X-Krawler" once per turn.

dreamtowerofprincessnemleria.name: Dream Tower of Princess Nemleria
dreamtowerofprincessnemleria.desc: You can banish 2 face-down cards from your Extra Deck, face-down; add 2 Level 10 Beast monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Pendulum Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Dream Tower of Princess Nemleria" once per turn. If a "Nemleria" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, while you have "Dreaming Nemleria" face-up in your Extra Deck, you can banish 1 face-down card from your Extra Deck face-down, instead.

fiendreflection1.name: Fiend Reflection #1
fiendreflection1.desc: This monster can draw its enemies into a mirror world that renders them helpless.

filiadiabell.name: Filia Diabell
filiadiabell.desc: Add 1 Level 8 or higher "Diabell" monster from your Deck to your hand, or if only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon it instead. If this card is banished: You can make all "Diabell" monsters you currently control gain 500 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Filia Diabell" once per turn.

finalflame.name: Final Flame
finalflame.desc: Inflict 600 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

fraudfreeze.name: Fraud Freeze
fraudfreeze.desc: Once per turn, when your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) from the hand (except during the Damage Step): You can return to the hand all monsters your opponent controls that were Special Summoned from the hand. If neither player controls a "Flower Cardian" Synchro Monster, send this card to the Graveyard.

genexdoctor.name: Genex Doctor
genexdoctor.desc: You can Tribute 1 face-up "Genex Controller" to select and destroy 1 card on the field.

heregoessomething.name: Here Goes Something!
heregoessomething.desc: Once per Duel, you can activate this Skill at the start of your Battle Phase, while you control exactly 1 "Elemental HERO" monster (and no other monsters). For the rest of this turn, that 1 monster gains 800 ATK while battling an opponent's monster and can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each, also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn.

hymnoflight.name: Hymn of Light
hymnoflight.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Saffira, Queen of Dragons". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 6 or more. If a Ritual Monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect while this card is in your Graveyard, you can banish this card instead.

incarnatedmachineangel.name: Incarnated Machine Angel
incarnatedmachineangel.desc: Your "Cyber Angel" Ritual Monsters cannot be destroyed by battle. When you take damage by battle or an opponent's card effect: You can Tribute 1 "Cyber Angel" Ritual Monster from your hand or field; Special Summon 1 "Cyber Angel" Ritual Monster from your hand. (This is treated as a Ritual Summon.) You can only use this effect of "Incarnated Machine Angel" once per turn.

judgeman.name: Judge Man
judgeman.desc: This club-wielding warrior battles to the end and will never surrender.

jungledweller.name: Jungle Dweller
jungledweller.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by card effect. While there are 2 cards in the Field Zones, your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Jungle Dweller" once per turn. You can banish 1 LIGHT or DARK monster from your GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can shuffle up to 2 of your Field Spells from your GY or banishment into the Deck, then you can destroy up to that many cards your opponent controls.

koakimeiruurnight.name: Koa'ki Meiru Urnight
koakimeiruurnight.desc: During each of your End Phases, destroy this card unless you send 1 "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" from your hand to the Graveyard or reveal 1 Beast-Warrior-Type monster in your hand. Once per turn, you can reveal 1 "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" in your hand to Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Koa'ki Meiru" monster from your Deck, except "Koa'ki Meiru Urnight".

lengling.name: Leng Ling
lengling.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. The original ATK of a monster equipped with this card becomes 1000, it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

madolchequeentiaramisu.name: Madolche Queen Tiaramisu
madolchequeentiaramisu.desc:
2 Level 4 "Madolche" monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target up to 2 "Madolche" cards in your Graveyard; shuffle those cards into the Deck, also, after that, shuffle cards your opponent controls into the Deck, up to the number of "Madolche" cards returned.

memorycrushking.name: Memory Crush King
memorycrushking.desc: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent by a direct attack, remove from play all Synchro Monsters in your opponent's Graveyard, and inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each monster removed.

multiply.name: Multiply
multiply.desc: Tribute 1 face-up "Kuriboh"; Special Summon as many "Kuriboh Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 200) as possible, in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

newworldamritara.name: New World - Amritara
newworldamritara.desc:
Activate only while "Visas Starfrost" is on the field. Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, and sent to the GY or banished: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 of those monsters in Defense Position.
● 1 Tuner on the field gains ATK equal to half the original ATK of 1 of those monsters.
● Shuffle 1 of those monsters into the Deck, and if you do, draw 1 card.
● Shuffle this card into the Deck, and if you do, add 1 Field Spell from your GY to your hand.

ninjitsuartofdancingleaves.name: Ninjitsu Art of Dancing Leaves
ninjitsuartofdancingleaves.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 "Ninja" monster or 1 face-down Defense Position monster on the field; Tribute it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Ninja" monster from your Deck. When this card leaves the field, send that monster to the GY. You can target 1 "Ninjitsu Art" Continuous Spell/Trap in your Spell & Trap Zone; return it to the hand. You can only use 1 "Ninjitsu Art of Dancing Leaves" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

number101silenthonorarksoulasylum.name: Number 101: Silent Honor ARK - Soul Asylum
number101silenthonorarksoulasylum.desc:
2 Level 4 monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Choose 1 Level 4 monster in your GY, except the detached material, and add 1 Level 4 monster with the same Type and Attribute, but a different name, from your Deck to your hand.
● Target 1 monster your opponent controls; attach it to this card.
You can only use this effect of "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK - Soul Asylum" once per turn. If this card would be destroyed, you can detach 1 material from this card instead.

parasomniapillow.name: Parasomnia Pillow
parasomniapillow.desc: During the End Phase: You can destroy the equipped monster. If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster was destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Parasomnia Token" (Level 1/ATK ?/DEF 0) with the equipped monster's original Type, Attribute, and ATK, then equip this card to that Token. You can only use each effect of "Parasomnia Pillow" once per turn.

preparationofrites.name: Preparation of Rites
preparationofrites.desc: Add 1 Level 7 or lower Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand, then you can add 1 Ritual Spell from your GY to your hand.

recall.name: Recall
recall.desc: When your opponent activates a monster effect: Your opponent draws 1 card, also negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

reptilianneechidna.name: Reptilianne Echidna
reptilianneechidna.desc:
2 monsters, including a Reptile monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change its ATK to 0. During your Main Phase, if your opponent controls a monster(s) with 0 ATK: You can add Reptile monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, up to the number of monsters your opponent controls with 0 ATK, also, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Reptile monsters. You can only use each effect of "Reptilianne Echidna" once per turn.

returnofthedoomed.name: Return of the Doomed
returnofthedoomed.desc: Discard 1 Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard. Return 1 of your monsters destroyed and sent to your Graveyard as a result of battle during this turn to your hand at the end of this turn.

skystrikermechahornetdrones.name: Sky Striker Mecha - Hornet Drones
skystrikermechahornetdrones.desc: If you control no monsters in your Main Monster Zone: Special Summon 1 "Sky Striker Ace Token" (Warrior/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position, which cannot be Tributed, and if you have 3 or more Spells in your GY when this effect resolves, the Token's ATK/DEF become 1500 instead.

solfachordsolfegia.name: Solfachord Solfegia
solfachordsolfegia.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
When your opponent's monster effect activated on the field resolves, if you control a "GranSolfachord" monster, you can negate that effect, then destroy this card. You can only use this effect of "Solfachord Solfegia" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Solfachord" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect (you can also Tribute this card); Special Summon 1 "Solfachord" monster from your hand, except "Solfachord Solfegia", or, if you Tributed this card when you activated this effect, you can Special Summon from your face-up Extra Deck or GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Solfachord Solfegia" once per turn.

sorcereroftheswamp.name: Sorcerer of the Swamp
sorcereroftheswamp.desc: If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and banish 1 material whose name is mentioned on it from your Deck, then Special Summon this card, and if you do, this card's name can be treated as the banished monster's, if used as Fusion Material this turn. You can only use this effect of "Sorcerer of the Swamp" once per turn.

succubusknight.name: Succubus Knight
succubusknight.desc: A warrior wizard adept in casting bone-chilling spells.

thundernyannyan.name: Thunder Nyan Nyan
thundernyannyan.desc: If there is a non-LIGHT monster on your side of the field, destroy this face-up card.

trickstarbouquet.name: Trickstar Bouquet
trickstarbouquet.desc: Target 1 "Trickstar" monster you control and 1 face-up monster on the field; return that "Trickstar" monster to the hand, and if you do, the other monster gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the returned monster, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Trickstar Bouquet" per turn.
